awaiting_decision.section: CI — web/'s whole browser lane moves into the container
awaiting_decision.scenario: You open a PR touching one button. CI runs, and the web job spends several minutes building the Next.js app — twice. The single build the whole container-move decision was chosen for never happens.
awaiting_decision.whats_wrong: The spec runs two scoped CI steps (test:e2e then test:vr) and claims they share one webServer and therefore one next build. Playwright's webServer is per-INVOCATION: it is torn down after each `playwright test` call.
awaiting_decision.spike_result: Throwaway two-project config with a webServer that logs each boot. One unscoped invocation -> 1 boot. Two scoped invocations -> 2 boots. Port confirmed NOT LISTENING between the scoped steps. With a survivor server and CI=true, step 2 errors 'is already used'.
awaiting_decision.also: V10 CONFIRMED — the ci.yml `build` job also builds web (pnpm run build -> pnpm -r), so the comparison table undercounts by one in EVERY column. Today is 2, not 1; the chosen option as written is 3.
options: One unscoped invocation in the web job (no --project), one artifact playwright-web-report. Restores the single build. The HTML report and list reporter already name the project per test, so a red lane is still identifiable. Dissolves V2 entirely (one run, no folder collision).
Keep two steps and state honestly that the web job pays two builds — the ranking vs the rejected options still holds, but the headline saving does not.

awaiting_decision.section: CI — Each lane writes to its own folder
awaiting_decision.scenario: Only relevant if two steps are kept. The VR step wipes the e2e step's traces, so a failing e2e test has no trace to replay.
awaiting_decision.whats_wrong: `pnpm ... run test:vr -- --output=DIR` — pnpm forwards the literal `--` and Playwright then IGNORES --output, so both steps write web/test-results/ and the second clears the first.
awaiting_decision.spike_result: With `-- --output=$OUT`: $OUT never created, artifacts in default test-results/. Without the `--`: $OUT populated, test-results/ not created. PLAYWRIGHT_HTML_OUTPUT_DIR works in both. Per-project outputDir verified to keep both folders in either order.
awaiting_decision.fix_if_two_steps: Declare outputDir per project in the config (outputDir: 'test-results-e2e' / 'test-results-vr'), drop `-- --output=`, keep the env vars, and add both folders to web/.gitignore.

awaiting_decision.section: Readiness, and why each wait is there
awaiting_decision.scenario: You open Punk.gp to shoot the long-score baseline. A dark toast slides in saying 'Punk.gp loaded' and slides away four seconds later. Whether the screenshot catches it whole, half-faded, or already gone depends on how fast that runner parsed the file — so the baseline is different on a slow CI runner than on your Mac, and the shot flakes forever.
awaiting_decision.whats_wrong: The long-score shot opens a file, which fires toast.loading then toast.success (PlayerShell.tsx:432, :467). Sonner's TOAST_LIFETIME is 4000ms and neither call sets a duration. The word 'toast' appears nowhere in the spec.
awaiting_decision.precedent: web/e2e/a11y.e2e.ts:83-91 already carries a settleToasts helper for this exact state; client/'s Sonner stories pin duration: Infinity because a self-dismissing toast cannot be photographed.
awaiting_decision.not_affected: The bundled-beat shot raises no toast — AlphaTab loads that score itself and nothing calls requestNotation.
awaiting_decision.fix: Add a toast-gone wait to the long-score shot: await expect(page.locator('[data-sonner-toast]')).toHaveCount(0) after the scroll check, before the shared fonts.ready block. Note that any other shot reaching its state by opening a file needs the same.

awaiting_decision.scenario: After the rename ships, you hit a red client VR run, open client/README.md to find out how to get the report, and it tells you to look for an artifact name that no longer exists.
awaiting_decision.whats_wrong: The spec renames the two existing CI artifacts but scopes the change to 'three lines in ci.yml'. Two prose docs name the old artifacts and are not in the footprint list.
awaiting_decision.verified: client/README.md:178 (playwright-vr-report) and :216 (playwright-e2e-report); docs/runbooks/vr-a11y-testing.md:50 (playwright-e2e-report). REFUTED for AGENTS.md — it names no artifact at all, and is already in the footprint list.
awaiting_decision.scope_note: This expands the implementing PR by two more files. That is the decision.
